The published package omits a license field and a full license file. Original author James Halliday's upstream commit 1b745ee35d33eb166e15ef1866073a07c6d7de87 declares MIT/X11 for the same 0.1.1 source. The original repository is unavailable; this exact original commit is preserved in the BitPay fork. No later fork copyright is substituted.
